title: Block function stopped working
body: I have used one sec for almost a year and was, until recently, very happy with the scheduled hard block function, where it automatically locks and opens apps according to the schedule. But recently, I have noticed that the block function is not working, so it doesn’t block my apps when it hits 15.00, like I have said it should + it doesn’t open them again either, unless I change the schedule… it’s very frustrating and kind of defeats the purpose for me personally. I am hoping this will be fixed cause besides that the app is perfect for me

title: Way too expensive
body:
The app has a good concept to reducing screen time. For what it delivers, though, it is way too expensive - especially as you need to pay a recurring license fee. The majn functionality is delivered by the native shortcut app. 
There are better and, more importantly, free alternatives in the App Store.
